boundary: Only synthetic test credentials used by author/reviewer; actual installed CLI ran offline display only.
No author transaction signing with user credentials, mainnet broadcast, registration retry or quote request.
One fixed RPC send per explicit invocation; no retries; deterministic hash flushed before send and returned on unknown outcome.
RPC success remains unverified until independent finalized reconciliation; neither return code nor hash proves settlement.
Fresh approval-specific expected nonce must be pinned by trusted caller when reconciling a previously uncertain attempt.
Retains owner recovery access; this operator harness is not OS isolation.

independent_review.scope: Read-only final diff/docs review and independent synthetic offline CLI test execution; no user credentials or broadcast
